value.rationale: The source leaves the exactly critical global trajectory uncharacterized. The theorem completes the natural extinction–persistence boundary and identifies two positive behavioral contributions to the universal infectious-time amplitude and an inaccessible-infectious t^-2 signature; the same R0 permits substantially different time-dependent burdens. A logarithmic cumulative-person-time consequence is relevant for critical surveillance, independently of finite computations.
